name: ODYSSEY 102
notes: Sketch-led working layout. See feedback for nine unresolved interpretations.

reviewFlags.title: Join and central exit
reviewFlags.text: The repeated bench/exit area appears once. Does it function as an enclosed dry room, a landing, or an open deck area? The sketch does not settle its enclosure or exit destination.

reviewFlags.title: Upper position and stair pairs
reviewFlags.text: A is the strongest match. D is a candidate second match based on its crosswise direction and left-side position. Upper room lengths and endpoint are a provisional fit, not established dimensions.

reviewFlags.title: Remaining changes in height
reviewFlags.text: B/C say DOWN in the machinery sketch; E is a rear stair mark. Their destinations are unknown. Do not delete them or claim that the full lower plan is one uninterrupted elevation.

reviewFlags.title: Bathroom entrances
reviewFlags.text: Fixture relationships follow the source, but some entrance/stall gaps are faint. Amber doors are conventional interpretations with clear swings, not verified door locations.

reviewFlags.title: Heating and tank identities
reviewFlags.text: The service strip contains storage, boiler/furnace labels and three oval/tank marks. Exact divisions and the identity of every tank are uncertain.

reviewFlags.title: Workshop partitions and labels
reviewFlags.text: Bench/shelf edges do not automatically become walls. Enlarged handwriting reads MIXED and STRAIGHT GAS below the tanks, plus INSTRUMENT BENCH on the right. The rear edge appears to be railing. The possible workshop divider remains provisional.

reviewFlags.title: Upper room access and footprint
reviewFlags.text: The office, desk/cabinet area and weight room are retained. The proposed internal door and lower exit provide a workable route, but their precise handings and the lower landing extent need review.

reviewFlags.title: Accommodation and written conflicts
reviewFlags.text: Only ten rooms are drawn. The write-up says twenty, ten per floor, plus upper laundry and first aid. Those additional spaces remain unlocated. L/R keys are review identifiers, not actual room numbers.

reviewFlags.title: Dimensions and graphic treatment
reviewFlags.text: Only the pad has marked local dimensions: 43 x 35 ft. Other lengths, exact hull form, pad centring, perimeter netting and physical door/fixture sizes are unverified. No extra helipad equipment is added.

sourceSummary: The sketches govern this working layout. Ten bedrooms are drawn; twenty are described in the write-up. Additional rooms and amenities remain unlocated. Nine review flags are saved in Feedback.
